text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Haaah, haaah... haaah...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Still breathing heavily, Daiwa Scarlet ran over
to the edge of the spectator stands.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Hmph... What are you looking so satisfied about?
A result like this is only natural.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
I'm aiming to be number one!
I can't afford to stumble right at the starting line.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Let's move on to the next preparations.
We don't have time to dilly-dally.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
With that said, Daiwa Scarlet
looked over toward the Turf Vision.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Listed there were the names of the
Umamusume running in the upcoming debut race.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Daiwa Scarlet intends to defeat them all—no, defeat everyone
she ever competes against—and become "Number One."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: In that case, surely the next path she is aiming for is—

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Trainer!
I'm taking the Tiara route!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Route selection. For Umamusume,
it's a crucial choice that shapes the rest of their lives.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Races you can only run once in a lifetime.
The Triple Crown: Satsuki Sho, Tokyo Yushun (Japanese Derby), Kikuka Sho.
The Triple Tiara: Oka Sho, Yushun Himba (Japanese Oaks), Shuka Sho.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Which path to take—it was a decision
akin to destiny for an athlete.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
"The Tiara route has produced
many beautifully radiant, renowned Umamusume."

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
So it's totally perfect for me, right?
Both distance-wise! And glamour-wise!
choice_data_list: That's a choice befitting of you.
That's a choice that's very like you.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Heheh, then it's settled!
Our next goal is the Tulip Sho.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...The Tulip Sho is well known as the gateway
to the Oka Sho. A victory there will certainly
open the doors to what lies ahead.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
"I'm going in to win, no matter what.
Regardless of who my opponents are."

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: "Because I'm aiming for 'Number 1.' I don't have any time to stand around idling."

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: ...Isn't that right, Trainer?
choice_data_list: Let's win the Tulip Sho, no matter what

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! First place belongs to me!
I'm not letting anyone take the lead!
